scope: Evidence-wrapper exit propagation only; NOT campaign/native physics failures or new physics acceptance

intentional_run_failure.probe_source:
#!/bin/sh
# Intentional helper-status probe, not a compiler or campaign test.
output=
while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
    if [ "$1" = "-o" ]; then
        shift
        output=${1:-}
        break
    fi
    shift
done
if [ "$output" != /tmp/hostaim_validation ]; then
    echo "unexpected probe output path" >&2
    exit 29
fi
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'echo INTENTIONAL_HELPER_RUN_FAILURE >&2' 'exit 7' > "$output" || exit 30
chmod +x "$output" || exit 31
echo INTENTIONAL_PROBE_COMPILER_SUCCEEDED
exit 0
